name: lovetrae-monorepo
description: A couples therapy app disguised as a game

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && python -m uvicorn server:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001" "cd app && npx expo start"
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd app && npm run export:web && firebase deploy --only hosting -P love-actually-thegame
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:gcloud && npm run deploy:frontend

author: LOVETRAE Team
